name.title: Platform log name
name.description: Retained platform log label. This value is preserved when saving settings.

name.title: Controller log label (optional)
name.description: Defaults to Controller 1, Controller 2, etc. This label does not rename Home accessories.

ipAddress.title: IP Address
ipAddress.description: The wall-mounted controller's IP address. A reserved address in your router is recommended.

port.title: Port
port.description: Controller API port: normally 2025; Fujitsu anywAIR systems use 10211. This is not the Homebridge child-bridge port.

debug.title: Detailed debug logging
debug.description: Include sanitised request timing, read summaries and command confirmations for this controller. No Homebridge Debug Mode required.

homeName.title: Name
homeName.description: Home accessory base name, e.g. Aircon or Downstairs Aircon. Additional aircons use Name 2, Name 3, etc. Use a distinct base for each controller. Zone names come from the controller.

excludedLightIds.title: Excluded MyPlace light IDs (optional)
excludedLightIds.description: Leave empty to discover all light outputs. Use controller light IDs, not names.

things.title: MyPlace Things (read-only preparation)
things.description: Optional explicit hardware selections. This increment creates no Home accessories and sends no commands. Leave empty unless the hardware and controller IDs are known. Keep identifiers private.

controllerId.title: Controller MID
controllerId.description: Exact system.mid for this controller, not its IP address or name. All entries here must belong to this controller.

id.title: Thing ID
id.description: Exact controller Thing ID, not its display name. Enter each ID only once.

type.title: Physical device type
type.description: Select the known installed hardware. Capability matching does not verify physical position, wiring or safe control. Relay fans require a known fan connected to a general relay; no speed control is inferred.

invert.title: Invert reported endpoints
invert.description: Swap the interpretation of reported 0 and 100. Does not alter controller values or establish physical position.

zoneControlType.title: Zone Control Type
zoneControlType.description: Choose Switches, Lights or Fans for zone controls in Apple Home. Switch / Light keeps the existing layout. Sensorless zones also have a damper-opening slider. Save and restart the child bridge (or Homebridge) to apply layout changes.

linkZoneTemperatures.title: Link Zone Temperatures
linkZoneTemperatures.description: For zones with supported temperature sensors, show readings within the corresponding zone controls instead of separate temperature accessories. Off by default; independent of Zone Control Type. Changing either Zone setting may remove affected Apple Home scenes or automation actions.

debug.title: Detailed debug logging for all controllers
debug.description: Enable detailed diagnostics for every controller. Individual selections are preserved when this is turned off. No Homebridge Debug Mode required.
